calendarFaqs.q: Are the SLPS two-hour early-release dates days off?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Students attend on October 14, 2026, and February 10, 2027, but are released two hours early for professional development. Families should confirm dismissal and transportation details with the school.

calendarFaqs.q: Do students have school during the SLPS parent-teacher conference weeks?
calendarFaqs.a: The district calendar lists conferences October 26–30 and March 22–25 but does not label those dates as districtwide no-school or early-release days. Check the assigned school for conference times and any school-specific schedule.

calendarFaqs.q: Are June 1–4, 2027, regular SLPS school days?
calendarFaqs.a: Not automatically. The calendar reserves June 1–4 as snow or make-up days if needed. Do not treat them as student attendance days unless SLPS announces that one or more dates will be used.

calendarFaqs.q: Are the SLPS high school finals dates districtwide days off?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The January 11–14 and May 24–27 finals periods apply to high school schedules, and senior finals run May 17–20. The district calendar does not label those periods as districtwide school closures.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the downloaded SLPS calendar update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The ICS file is a one-time import and does not sync with later SLPS revisions, weather decisions, or activated make-up days. Check the official SLPS calendar before relying on a date that may change.
